paragraphs.en: We all grew up hearing people tell us to “go out and get some fresh air.”But is fresh air really as good for you as your mother always said? According to recent studies, everyone should step outside and take a deep {breath} of fresh air, if the air quality in their {camping} area is good.
paragraphs.cn: 我们都是在听着人们说“出去呼吸点新鲜空气”这样的话中长大的。但新鲜空气真的像妈妈一直说的那样对我们有好处吗？根据最近的研究，如果所处 <u> 露营 </u> 地的空气质量良好，每个人都应该走到户外，深深地 <u> 吸 </u> 一口新鲜空气。

paragraphs.en: Fresh air {cleans} our {lungs} , helping to reduce the symptoms of {flu} or a persistent {cough} .If the air you're {breathing} is clean—which it would be if you're away from the {smog} of cities—then the air is filled with {life-giving} , {energizing} oxygen.If you exercise out of {doors} , for example, taking a {bike} ride or enjoying a {hike} up a mountain, your body will start to breathe more deeply, allowing even more oxygen to get to your {muscles} and your brain.
paragraphs.cn: 新鲜空气可以 <u> 清洁 </u> 我们的 <u> 肺部 </u> ，有助于减轻 <u> 流感 </u> 或持续 <u> 咳嗽 </u> 的症状。如果你 <u> 呼吸 </u> 的空气是洁净的——如果你远离城市的 <u> 烟雾 </u> ，空气就会是这样的——那么空气中就充满了 <u> 能维持生命 </u> 、 <u> 让人充满活力的 </u> 氧气。如果你在 <u> 户 </u> 外锻炼，比如骑 <u> 自行车 </u> 或 <u> 徒步 </u> 登山，你的身体将会开始进行更深的呼吸，从而让更多的氧气输送到你的 <u> 肌肉 </u> 和大脑中。

paragraphs.en: Recently, people have begun studying the connection between the {natural} world and healing ( (治愈) ).Imagine sitting by a {fountain} , watching a {rainbow} form after a light drizzle, or simply enjoying the {windy} {weather} on a clear day.All across the country, {recovery} centers have begun building Healing Gardens.In these places, patients can go to be near nature during their recovery.It turns out that just looking at green, growing {grass} and trees can reduce stress, lower blood pressure, and put people into a better mood. {Greenery} is good for us. {Hospital} patients who see tree {branches} from their {window} are likely to recover at a {faster} rate than patients who see {buildings} or {sky} instead.Being in nature refreshes us, as we hear the birds singing or spot an {eagle} flying.It gives us a great feeling of {peace} .
paragraphs.cn: 最近，人们开始研究 <u> 自然 </u> 世界与疗愈之间的关系。试想一下，坐在 <u> 喷泉 </u> 旁边欣赏小雨过后 <u> 彩虹 </u> 的形成，或者仅仅是在晴朗的日子里享受清 <u> 风 </u> 拂面的 <u> 天气 </u> 。在全国各地，许多 <u> 康复 </u> 中心开始修建疗愈花园。在这些花园里，病人可以在康复期间亲近大自然。事实证明，仅仅是看着绿色的、生长中的 <u> 草 </u> 木，就能减轻压力，降低血压，让人心情变好。 <u> 绿色植物 </u> 对我们有益。那些从病房 <u> 窗户 </u> 望出去能看到 <u> 树枝 </u> 的住 <u> 院 </u> 病人，相比那些只能看到 <u> 建筑 </u> 或 <u> 天空 </u> 的病人，康复速度可能更 <u> 快 </u> 。身处大自然能让我们精神焕发，因为我们能听到鸟儿歌唱，还能看到 <u> 老鹰 </u> 飞翔。这带给我们一种 <u> 平静祥和 </u> 的美妙感受。

paragraphs.en: Another side benefit of getting fresh air is {sunlight} .While the sun's {rays} can age and {hurt} our {skin} , they also give us beneficial {vitamin} D, which is crucial for maintaining strong {bones} .To make sure you get enough vitamin D—but still protect your skin from skin {cancer} —put on {sunscreen} right as you {head} outside.It takes sunscreen about {fifteen} minutes to start working, and that period is typically enough for your skin to {absorb} a day's worth of vitamin D.Besides, sunlight has a positive effect on our mood, bringing {cheer} and helping to ease feelings of {sorrow} .
paragraphs.cn: 呼吸新鲜空气还有一个额外的好处，那就是（能接触到） <u> 阳光 </u> 。虽然太阳 <u> 光线 </u> 会使我们的 <u> 皮肤 </u> 老化、 <u> 受损 </u> ，但这些光线也能为我们提供有益的 <u> 维生素 </u> D，这对于保持 <u> 骨骼 </u> 强壮至关重要。为了确保获取足量的维生素D，同时又能保护皮肤免受皮肤 <u> 癌 </u> 的侵害， <u> 出 </u> 门时应立即涂抹 <u> 防晒霜 </u> 。防晒霜大约需要 <u> 十五 </u> 分钟才开始发挥作用，这段时间通常足以让皮肤 <u> 吸收 </u> 一天所需的维生素D量。此外，阳光对我们的情绪也有积极的影响，它会带来 <u> 快乐 </u> ，并有助于缓解 <u> 悲伤 </u> 的情绪。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
